content:
jordan: Quick heads-up — ran a cross-region bring-up bench for Llama/Mistral/Qwen comparing ROPE vs GQA kernels. Noticed H100 in eu-west has ~2x p95 for Llama+GQA at seq_len=8192 vs us-west. Dropping logs here, want a sanity check before filing infra ticket.

anya: can you paste the exact command + job ids?

jordan: sure, run command + summary below:
```
bench-run --model llama-70b --seq 8192 --kernel gqa --quant quant4a --region eu-west --gpu H100 --batch 1 --ctxsplit 1024 --warmup 0 --id job_2005_eu_h100_01
bench-run --model llama-70b --seq 8192 --kernel gqa --quant quant4a --region us-west --gpu H100 --batch 1 --ctxsplit 1024 --warmup 0 --id job_2005_us_h100_01
```
summary (p50 / p95 / tokens/s):
eu-west H100 Llama+GQA: 95ms / 420ms / 12.3 toks/s
us-west H100 Llama+GQA: 85ms / 210ms / 13.7 toks/s
eu-west H100 Mistral+GQA: 70ms / 180ms / 14.1 toks/s
eu-west H100 Qwen+GQA: 80ms / 200ms / 13.9 toks/s

mike: did you run with ctxsplit on and KV-cache warmup? could be cache warmup + interconnect noise.

jordan: ctxsplit=1024 enabled, kv-warmup=false for these first runs. I re-ran with kv-warmup=true and p95 dropped to ~240ms (still ~15% slower than us-west).

liam: can you paste the kernel selection log from the runtime? might be falling back to a slower path on eu nodes.

jordan: pasted kernel log snippet:
```
[kernel-select] model=llama-70b seq=8192 -> candidate kernels: gqa_opt_v1, gqa_fallback_v2, rope_native_v0
[kernel-select] tried gqa_opt_v1 -> failed (cudaMemcpyAsync OOM on SM 2)
[kernel-select] tried gqa_fallback_v2 -> selected (extra memcpy + transposes)
[perf] selected_kernel=gqa_fallback_v2 memcpy_overhead=28ms transpose_overhead=30ms
```
seems eu-west H100 nodes choose gqa_fallback_v2 while us-west picks gqa_opt_v1. Not sure why gqa_opt_v1 fails only in eu.

ml-bot: Bench summary uploaded -> https://internal/bench/2005001234 (csv + per-region charts). Automated diff shows eu-west p95 delta +210ms for llama-70b gqa @8192 vs us-west.

anya: :thinking: two quick checks: driver + cuda version diff between regions, and machine topology (nvlink config / PCIe gen). Also try quant=NF4 to rule out quant packer differences.

mike: I'll repro on eu H100 with ctxsplit disabled and a rope-only kernel request (force kernel=rope_native_v0). If gqa_opt_v1 is unstable on that host, forcing rope might be faster for long ctx. @liam can you watch infra (we might need kernel binary sync)?

jordan: thanks — saving the config used so we can reproduce: model=llama-70b, seq=8192, kernel=GQA, batch=1, quant=quant4a, ctxsplit=1024, kv-warmup=false, runtime=redwood-infer-v2. Will attach full traces to the infra issue after repro.

liam: on it. spinning a host repro and checking driver packages across the eu pool. will post findings in this thread.
